## ✅ Acceptance Criteria (Definition of Done)
<!-- What must be TRUE for a reviewer to approve — these verify the result, not the steps. -->
- [ ] *Example: The product card displays title, image, and price correctly on mobile and desktop*
- [ ] *Example: Clicking a product card navigates to `/products/[id]`*
- [ ] The app builds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] The changes render and behave as expected in the browser
- [ ] Relevant docs or setup instructions are updated (if applicable)
